results.prompt: I missed Tuesday’s 35-minute easy run. I have 35 minutes free Thursday at 6:30 PM. I want to keep Saturday’s long run. What do you recommend?
results.text:
Thursday already has the 40-minute steady run at 6:45 AM, so adding a second run at 6:30 PM would make it a double-run day and add fatigue close to Saturday’s long run.

Best fit: **don’t make up Tuesday’s full 35 minutes.** Keep Thursday’s steady run as planned, Friday strength/mobility, and Saturday’s 60-minute long easy run. One missed easy run is usually the lower-cost choice versus stacking extra running into an already busy stretch.

If you strongly want some of the missed volume, a lower-risk compromise is:
- **Thursday evening:** 15–20 minutes *very easy* only if Thursday morning’s steady run feels controlled and your legs are fresh.
- Keep it genuinely easy—this is extra aerobic movement, not another quality session.
- If you do that, be willing to shorten Saturday’s long run slightly if you feel unusually heavy or sore.

I’d choose **no make-up** this week: preserve the steady-run/long-run spacing and arrive at Saturday fresher.

results.prompt: That sounds good. Please prepare the plan you recommended.
results.text:
I’ll keep the week as currently scheduled: Tuesday’s missed easy run stays missed; Thursday remains the 40-minute steady run at 6:45 AM; Friday strength/mobility and Saturday’s 60-minute long easy run stay in place.
